第9章 前往君家有点向往君家了（第1页）
“娘还好，你不用担心，只是你以后在君家就要学会照顾自己，君家不比林家，你要学会多担待”
“我会的，娘亲你在家也要好好照顾自己”
“嗯，娘知道了，不多说了，人家君家神子还在等着你，不能再耽搁了，让人家久等不好。”
“对了，这些蜜饯海棠你带上吧，路上有空再吃”
“嗯，那我去了，娘亲您多多保重”
儿行千里母担忧，看着儿子消失在眼角尽头，眼中满是忧愁。
林家大门前，一切准备就绪，身为神子，出门自然不缺坐骑。
一只身形雄壮，威武不凡，气息强横的大雕在君傲天身旁匍匐，尽显神子的意气风范。
林琅天看着眼前的大雕，心想这应该是传说中的鲲鹏，一跃万里，飞行极速，赶路小能手，拉风的很。
以后有机会自己也要弄一只，最起码也要，不比这个差。
“林琅天，去了君家要知礼识尊，不要在林家这样，不懂事”
尚不待林琅天回答，林家主又向神子客气的道别：
“神子一路匆忙，路途迢迢来林家，林家都没怎么好好接待，这是一点手信，希望神子能够收下。”
说着就递过一个空间戒指，献媚的很，林琅天还看到林浩宇眼中的不甘与羡慕。
君家神子开始是不屑，但后来眼珠一转，不知想到什么，伸手接过，气平神安的说了句：
“哈哈，应该的”见神子收下，林家主也是眉开眼笑。
君傲天向林琅天说道，发现林琅天目光看向远处的别苑，心中一动，回头看着林家：
“林琅天的娘亲以后也是我小妹怡雪的娘亲，我不希望听到，她在林家过的有不好的消息”。
“哈哈哈，神子多心了，林琅天的娘亲也是我内人，我自然不会亏待他”。
“是啊，以后林家，君家就是一家人，肯定不会有什么不好的事发生”
林琅天看着君傲天的所为，心中也是莫名感动，想不到这个大舅哥为人挺好的，处处为他着想。
“走了”君傲天一把抓紧林琅天的肩膀，一跃而起，降落在鲲鹏的身上。
接着大雕冲天而起，林家逐渐消失身后。
看着脚下大地飞快掠过，心中顿时想起前世的一句话：
“学做鲲鹏飞万里，不做燕雀恋子巢”
君傲天，一直关注着林琅天的行为举止，发现由始至终林琅天都表现出一副淡定，泰然自若的样子。
看来不像是装的，装的话应该会有漏洞，不可能到现在都是一如既往。
是个可堪之才，虽说现在还没有修为，但君家是何等世家，林家搞不定的君家能搞定，林家搞的定的，君家搞的更好。
如果连君家都搞不定，那天荒就没有哪个世家能搞定了。
看着林琅天自从出了林家之后，就一直怔怔出神，不知道想啥？
“嗯？担心什么”林琅天一时之间没回神来直接问道；
“其实君家没有外面传的一般强势，只是君家比较团结，也比较护短，只要是君家人，只要在外受了欺负，君家都会讨回公道”。
“当然了，君家也是小辈的事小辈处理，如果对方以大压小，君家才会出面，这也是为了锻炼年轻一辈”。
“你的事情，我君家也有了解，林家做事不公，我君家不会，相反，你越出色，君家越会培养你，不管你是什么出身”
“只要你入了君家门，就是君家人，你不能修炼的问题，我们君家也会处理，所以你完全不用担心”
“哼，那些世家永远都是只会在勾心斗角，窝里横，互相伤害，这种目光短浅，毫无大局观的家族，永远都不可以登临顶峰，只配俯首”
君傲天看着林琅天，说了很多话，林琅天也是认真在听，难怪荒古世家以君为首，天荒以中天道域为尊。
就凭君家的家族核心价值观，处事方式，不登顶才是怪事。

Chapter 9 Going to Jun’s house and yearning for Jun’s house (Page 1)
"Mom, it's okay. You don't have to worry. It's just that you have to learn to take care of yourself in the Jun family. The Jun family is no better than the Lin family. You have to learn to take more care of yourself."
"I will. Mom, you should take good care of yourself at home."
"Well, I understand, mother. I won't say any more. The Lord of the Jun family is still waiting for you. You can't delay any longer. It's not good to keep people waiting for a long time."
"By the way, take these candied crabapples with you and eat them when you have time on the way."
"Well, I'm going then. Mother, please take care of yourself."
The mother was worried when her son traveled thousands of miles. She watched her son disappear from the corner of her eyes, her eyes full of sorrow.
In front of the Lin family's gate, everything was ready. As the Son of God, he naturally had no shortage of mounts when he went out.
A large eagle with a majestic body, extraordinary power, and a powerful aura was crawling beside Jun Aotian, showing the spirit and demeanor of the Son of God.
Lin Langtian looked at the big eagle in front of him and thought that this should be the legendary Kunpeng. He could leap thousands of miles and fly very fast. He was a little expert on the road and was very impressive.
I will get one myself if I have the chance in the future, at the very least, no worse than this one.
"Lin Langtian, when you go to Jun's house, you must know etiquette and respect. Don't be like this in Lin's house and be ignorant."
Before Lin Langtian could answer, the head of the Lin family said goodbye politely to the Son of God:
"The Son of God was in a hurry and came all the way to the Lin family. The Lin family didn't receive him well. This is a little souvenir. I hope the Son of God can accept it."
After saying that, he handed over a space ring, which was very flattering. Lin Langtian also saw the unwillingness and envy in Lin Haoyu's eyes.
The Divine Son of the Jun family was disdainful at first, but then he rolled his eyes and thought of something. He stretched out his hand to take it and said calmly:
"Haha, that's right." Seeing the Son of God accept it, the head of the Lin family also smiled happily.
Jun Aotian said to Lin Langtian, and noticed that Lin Langtian was looking at Bieyuan in the distance. His heart moved, and he turned back to look at the Lin family:
"Lin Langtian's mother will also be the mother of my little sister Yixue. I don't want to hear bad news about her life in the Lin family."
"Hahaha, the Son of God is overly concerned. Lin Langtian's mother is also my wife, so naturally I won't treat him badly."
"Yes, from now on, the Lin family and the Jun family will be one family, and nothing bad will happen to them."
Lin Langtian was inexplicably moved when he saw what Jun Aotian did. He never expected that this uncle was a very kind person and always thought of him.
"Let's go." Jun Aotian grabbed Lin Langtian's shoulders, jumped up, and landed on Kunpeng.
Then the big eagle soared into the sky, and the Lin family gradually disappeared behind them.
Watching the ground fly by quickly under my feet, I suddenly remembered a sentence from my previous life:
"Learn to be like a Kunpeng flying thousands of miles, don't be like a sparrow in love with its children."
Jun Aotian had been paying attention to Lin Langtian's behavior and found that Lin Langtian showed a calm and collected look from the beginning to the end.
It doesn't seem like it's just an act. If it were, there would be loopholes. It can't be the same as it is now.
He is an impressive talent. Although he has no cultivation level yet, what a noble family the Jun family is. If the Lin family cannot handle it, the Jun family can handle it. If the Lin family can handle it, the Jun family can handle it even better.
If even the Jun family can't handle it, no other family can handle it that day.
Lin Langtian has been in a daze since he left the Lin family. I don't know what he is thinking.
"Huh? What are you worried about?" Lin Langtian asked directly without regaining consciousness for a while;
"Actually, the Jun family is not as strong as outsiders say. It's just that the Jun family is relatively united and protective of shortcomings. Anyone who is a member of the Jun family will seek justice if they are bullied outside."
"Of course, the Jun family's affairs are also handled by the younger generation. If the other party suppresses the younger generation with the big one, the Jun family will step in. This is also to train the younger generation."
"My Jun family also understands your matter. The Lin family does things unfairly, but my Jun family will not. On the contrary, the more outstanding you are, the more the Jun family will train you, no matter what your background is."
"As long as you enter the Jun family, you are a member of the Jun family. Our Jun family will also handle the problem of your inability to practice, so you don't have to worry at all."
"Hmph, those aristocratic families will always only scheming, fighting each other, and hurting each other. Such short-sighted families with no overall perspective will never be able to reach the top and only deserve to bow their heads."
Jun Aotian looked at Lin Langtian and said a lot, and Lin Langtian also listened attentively. No wonder the Huanggu family is headed by Jun, and Tianhuang regards the Zhongtian Dao domain as the most respected.
Based on the Jun family's core family values ​​and way of doing things, it would be weird not to reach the top.
